signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.body: ZenthOs signs you in through GitHub, with the same App that acts on your repositories. Only allowlisted logins get in.
signIn.notAllowed: If GitHub sent you back here, your login is not on the allowlist.

runs.title: Runs
runs.empty: No runs yet. Start one with a ticket key, or add the zenthos:run label on an issue.

run.clickToInspect: Click a step to inspect it
run.graphAria: The run's state machine with the path this run took
run.costNote: Estimates come from the agents' own token counts at list price; the invoice is the Console's number.

offRamp.needs_human: This run left the path and waits for a person: resume it from the state it was in, or abandon it.
offRamp.failed: This run failed and will not continue.

settings.title: Settings
settings.connectedBanner: GitHub sent you back: the connection below was created or its installations were updated.

setup.title: Set up ZenthOs
setup.intro: Three steps before the first run. Each one turns green as soon as it is true.
setup.connectHint: Create a GitHub App from the manifest (recommended), connect one you made, or use a personal token.
setup.installHint: The app acts only where it is installed. A token acts wherever its owner can.
setup.repoHint: Which commands may run, which ones gate a pull request, and the limits of a run.

settings.manifestIntro: GitHub opens with the app already described; you confirm, install it, and come back here.
settings.ownerHint: Leave empty to create it under your account
settings.existingAppIntro: For an app created by hand on GitHub. The private key is checked against GitHub before anything is stored, then sealed at rest.
settings.tokenIntro: Interim, for one account. GitHub is asked first; a refused token is not stored.
settings.notInstalled: Not installed anywhere yet. Install it to let it act on a repository.
settings.notCovered: The app of this connection is not installed on this repository, so runs will fail to act on it.
settings.confirmRemoveConnection: Remove the connection {{name}}? Repositories that use it fall back to the environment credentials.
settings.confirmRemoveRepo: Remove the profile for {{repo}}? Runs for it will be refused.

repoForm.allowedHint: Exact lines; nothing else runs in the sandbox.
repoForm.gatesLabel: Gate commands: must exit 0 before a pull request opens
repoForm.noAllowed: Add allowed commands first; gates are picked from them.
repoForm.forbidden: Extra forbidden path prefixes, one per line
repoForm.forbiddenHint: A change touching these needs a person.
repoForm.alwaysForbidden: Always forbidden: the files that define the gates
